_nav_breakpoint_comment: SHELL.md r6/r11: the breakpoint belongs to the surface and is BISECTED, never computed. RE-BISECTED 2026-09-05 in Chromium (agent-browser set viewport, the stacking rule overridden in the page so the unstacked nav could be measured) after the header nav was rewritten to Pipeline · Worlds · Evidence · Correct us · Source: the unstacked nav is two rows at 551px and one row from 552px, so the header stacks at 580px, 28px before the wrap. _ink_box_comment: SHELL.md r7, second item: a line-height set against the em size can be smaller than the font's actual ink, and consecutive lines then overlap — agentromatic's Syne h1 overlapped by 11.8px and a descender collided with the cap-height beneath it. MEASURED here rather than assumed, 2026-08-17 in Chrome at 1280, by rendering each element's own text in its own computed font to a canvas and comparing actualBoundingBoxAscent+actualBoundingBoxDescent against the computed line box. Space Grotesk 600 at 57.6px inks 51.0px inside a 60.5px box. Every value above is headroom in pixels and every one is positive, so nothing here needed changing. Re-measured at 390/700/1280/1600 for the h1: +4.1 / +5.2 / +9.5 / +9.5. THE PUBLICATION GATE CANNOT CHECK THIS — it has no font engine and no browser — so it is a recorded measurement, not an enforced law, and it is said that way on purpose.

surface_rung_covers: the graphonomous/v2 lane in the repository — its adapters, projector, WRL world builder and TRVM certificate, its sealed projections, and its test suite run on this machine. Nothing from it has been published anywhere
definition: Graphonomous is the persistent semantic/evidence graph that makes what a system understands queryable, falsifiable, provenance-linked and reducible.
boundary: It is a derived projection over registries that already hold the truth. It may derive, relate, rank, challenge, detect inconsistency and propose. It never promotes evidence: that stays with the owning registry, factory or adjudication.

status.statement: The lane at v2/ in the repository passes [[tests_pass]] of [[tests_total]] tests, with [[tests_skipped]] skipped by design, and seals [[worlds_sealed]] projections as WallRiderLang worlds, each with a TRVM certificate that re-verifies from its own directory. Nothing from it is in any published package.
status.source: npm run test:full-tree in graphonomous/v2 at the commit witness.json names, against sibling checkouts pinned by commit; g0 verify, verify-eval, check-cert and consistency over every shipped projection in the same run. Every figure on this page is emitted from records/witness.json, and check.mjs re-derives each derivable one from the lane and from WRL's own module.
status.limit: Everything above was run on one machine, by the people who wrote it, against registries they also maintain. Nothing here establishes that anyone else has reproduced the [[tests_total]] tests, that the graph is useful rather than merely sound, or that a reader can install anything — there is no published artifact, and the package under this name on the npm registry is an earlier engine this page does not describe. The demo on this domain was generated from the same tree and is not independent evidence.

advance.requires: A packaged lane a reader can run locally — a released bundle that carries the pinned registries it needs — and then the same verdict, [[tests_pass]] of [[tests_total]], from a machine that is not this one.

pipeline.title: Pin
pipeline.what: A snapshot names every repository it reads by commit, tree and blob — [[pinned_sources]] of them for the largest one, Super (CD) at [[super_pin]] among them. A blob that has moved is refused, never re-read.

pipeline.title: Ingest
pipeline.what: [[adapters]] adapters read those bytes and emit nodes, relations, assertions and source locations. What an adapter cannot normalize becomes a typed fault beside the records — [[faults]] of them in the largest projection — not a guess.

pipeline.title: Project
pipeline.what: The records fold into one content-addressed root. Shuffle the inputs, reverse the adapters, build again: the same root, and a Python twin re-derives it from the manifest alone.
pipeline.refusal: a root that does not re-derive

pipeline.title: Seal
pipeline.what: The semantic world is submitted to WallRiderLang as a Semantic IR 2.0 artifact under a profile Graphonomous declared as data — [[roles]] roles, [[kinds]] kinds, [[pairs]] admissible pairs. WRL's kernel mints the world id and every relation and revision id. Graphonomous submits; it never mints.

pipeline.title: Certify
pipeline.what: A certificate is minted through TRVM over the claim, its aggregate and the chain of code identities that produced it. It says under which verifier coordinates the projection reconstructs — never that it is "still valid".

pipeline.title: Check
pipeline.what: A checker re-derives every plane from the directory and writes nothing. Across families, a consistency pass names what two normalized sources disagree about — [[findings]] findings on the largest world, the sharpest being one file read at two different blobs.

published_artifact.label: A reader can obtain and run what this page describes
published_artifact.description: No artifact has been published. The package under this name on the npm registry is an earlier engine and is not what this page describes. Until a bundle exists that carries the pinned registries it needs, the only way to run this is a full checkout.

independent_use.label: Someone who is not us produced a result with it
independent_use.description: The only rung nobody here can award themselves. A reproduced verdict from another machine, a filed issue, or a fork that runs the suite.
